People: Bahá'u'lláh (author, Wikidata Q101054), died 1892. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bahá'u'lláh, 1817-1892") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Gleanings From The Writing Of Bahaullah, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.188780. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 93%, 100%, 94% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Bahá'u'lláh, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
